objectives.en: Write enqueue, dequeue, isEmpty, size and peek
Simulate a real queue in Python

narration.en: A Python list can be a queue too. Add with append() at the end, and remove from index 0 with pop(0).
narration.kn: ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಕ್ಯೂ ಆಗಿಯೂ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. append() ನಿಂದ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, pop(0) ನಿಂದ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ 0 ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.

body.en: Create an empty list, myQueue = list(). enqueue(myQueue, element) uses append(), so the end of the list is the REAR. isEmpty returns True when len(myQueue) == 0. dequeue checks isEmpty and then returns myQueue.pop(0), the FRONT element; otherwise it reports that the queue is empty. size returns len(myQueue), and peek returns myQueue[0]. IS FULL is not needed because a Python list grows as required.

IS FULL is not needed because a Python list grows as required.
narration.kn: myQueue = list(). enqueue: append(); dequeue: isEmpty ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ pop(0); size: len(); peek: myQueue[0]. ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ IS FULL ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ.
